dedupe_keys.name: kystdatahuset maritime traffic data warehouse of the norwegian coastal administration ais and port calls

description: Kystdatahuset is the maritime traffic data warehouse of the Norwegian Coastal Administration (Kystverket). It holds historical data on port calls to Norwegian ports, sailing patterns and traffic types, built from high-resolution AIS data and port call notifications from ships to SafeSeaNet Norway, cleaned and enriched with ship information without losing precision. Data can be used in two ways: dashboards and queries under numbers and statistics, with maps, charts and tables that can be filtered and exported to Excel or GeoJSON, and a data sharing portal with 30 to 40 datasets for download, including a download service for AIS data by period and area, yearly files for 2014 to 2020 of all arrivals reported in SafeSeaNet and geographic layers such as pilot boarding areas. Coverage is national (Norwegian waters). Access is open to everyone but needs a user name and password on the site; no licence was stated on the page read. Caveats: coverage depends on AIS reception and ship reporting, and the port call files stop in 2020. It supports port traffic analysis, exposure of shipping lanes and ports to storms and incidents, and emergency response planning. It complements the Danish Maritime Authority AIS data and is related to the Global Fishing Watch data.
